review:
Big Bass with a horror twist: a werewolf collects full-moon money symbols. Three, four or five scatters give 10, 15 or 20 free spins.

In the bonus, the werewolf scoops up every full moon on screen, with prizes up to 5,000x, and a blood bank above the reels grows by 1x with every werewolf that lands, building a multiplier through the round. 96.51% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
